articles.title: Hundreds of websites deliver potent malware cocktail to unsuspecting visitors
articles.content: Malware cocktail delivers cryptocurrency theft payloads and iOS exploits, among other things.
articles.titleZh: 数百个网站向毫无戒心的访客提供强大的恶意软件组合
articles.contentZh: 恶意软件组合会传播加密货币盗窃载荷和iOS漏洞利用等内容。

articles.title: Grok Bot took unapproved actions, ignored orders to stop, and then denied it
articles.content: AI agent takes unapproved actions even when laptop lid is closed and told not to.
articles.titleZh: Grok Bot 采取了未经批准的操作，无视停止的指令，然后否认了这一点
articles.contentZh: 即使笔记本电脑合上且被告知不要采取未批准的操作，AI 代理仍会采取此类操作。

articles.title: Shareholders sue Intel, its CEO, and CFO after stock drops 28.6 percent in one day
articles.content: The PC sales slump "more than offset” AI boom gains, shareholders say.
articles.titleZh: 英特尔股价一日内大跌28.6%，股东起诉英特尔及其首席执行官和首席财务官
articles.contentZh: 股东表示，个人电脑销售的暴跌“远远抵消了”人工智能热潮带来的收益。

articles.title: Windows 0-day dropped by disgruntled researcher hands hackers System rights
articles.content: "SignDrop" exploit lets local users gain all-powerful System rights.
articles.titleZh: 不满的研究人员曝出Windows 0-day漏洞，黑客得以获得系统权限
articles.contentZh: “SignDrop”漏洞利用可让本地用户获得全能的系统权限。

articles.title: Elon Musk tries to explain what’s going on with Ukraine and Starlink
articles.content: Elon Musk said Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy is lying about disruptions to Starshield in Ukraine and that he's trying to misuse SpaceX's consumer service, Starlink, for military purposes. Musk made the comments at The New York Times' DealBook Summit on Wednesday as he tried to explain the conflict following weeks of back and forth between […]
articles.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克试图解释乌克兰和星链之间发生了什么
articles.contentZh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在乌克兰Starshield服务中断一事上撒了谎，而且他正试图将SpaceX的消费级服务Starlink挪用于军事目的。马斯克周三在《纽约时报》的DealBook峰会上发表了上述言论，试图解释双方数周来争论不休的冲突。

articles.title: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search
articles.content: New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago schools are considering Google alternatives after the company said it will disable Search for schools that opt out of its AI features, according to The New York Times. Starting next year, schools will not have the option to disable Gemini-powered features without also disabling Search. Chris Phillips, Google's vice […]
articles.titleZh: 美国最大的学区正考虑弃用谷歌搜索
articles.contentZh: 据《纽约时报》报道，在谷歌表示将对选择不使用其人工智能功能的学校禁用搜索功能后，纽约、洛杉矶和芝加哥的学校正在考虑使用谷歌的替代方案。从明年开始，学校将无法在不禁用搜索功能的情况下禁用由Gemini提供支持的功能。谷歌副总裁Chris Phillips […]
